registration.baseline_definition: A is frozen PR2 canonical split + PR1 trace; source inventory is preserved pre-PR3 frontend/worker hashes plus PR2 canonical ZIP. Not bare64e1665 and not rebuilt from active PR3 source.
registration.single_change: PR3 light entry with explicit unique EvaluationController/Worker ownership, lifecycle and early dynamic App mounting; same PR2 canonical core.
registration.trace_comparability_note: Both A and B require the same final PR1 trace analyzer and identical external editable/move/hash measurement harness; same browser/runtime/lock. No producttrace or canonical-model optimization is added in this comparison.

A.source_revision: 64e1665 + PR1 instrumentation + PR2 canonical split working snapshot

B.source_revision: 64e1665 + independently reviewed PR1/PR2 + final frozen PR3 unique-worker light-entry candidate
B.source_fingerprint_scope: PR3-candidate-source-runtime-inventory.json; actual frozen runtime source plus seven explicit implementation/test files

execution_preconditions: Parent final freeze GO and stated independent browser correctness satisfied; exact source and dist identities reverified offline
Independent final prereg comparability review still required before execution
Only root executes once in exclusive window; no concurrent browser or heavy CPU work
Retain all failures and fixed10attempts; no retries or edits to earlier registration/result files

device.requested_renderer: SwiftShader flags; no observed GPU identity claim

method: Fixed AB/BA/AB/BA/AB; one Chromium; ten sequential fresh contexts; no warm reload, extra hot Worker, retries or sample exclusion. Exact frozen production rAF predicate and real accepted edit; confirmation includes automation scheduling. Nearest-rank percentiles.
limits: Ten cold attempts only; hot150ms gate NOT_RUN by this harness; final original enforce required.
Fresh browser contexts do not clear OS cache or all shared process state.
Only synthetic localhost scene; real GLB, public network, Edge and Safari NOT_RUN.
Trace stages may overlap; use thread epochs and analyzer, never sum marginal percentiles.
No population statistical-significance claim. Source revision/fingerprint/lock declarations are pre-registered provenance; served distribution/core hashes and actual UI core are verified.
